name: Apollo Laser Retroreflectors
summary: Laser ranging retroreflectors are optical prism arrays still used for research today.
hook: I require zero power and scientists on Earth still bounce laser beams off my prisms.
how_it_worked: Corner-cube fused-silica prisms reflect incident laser pulses back toward their precise origin on Earth.
science: Confirmed that the Moon is spiraling away from Earth at a rate of 3.8 centimeters per year.

facts.text: These retroreflectors are the only Apollo surface experiments still in active operational scientific use.
The Apollo 15 reflector array contains 300 corner cubes, three times larger than Apollo 11.

image.alt: Apollo 11 Laser Ranging Retro-Reflector and seismic experiment deployed on the lunar surface, seen from the Lunar Module
